event_summary: A wide desert landscape remains fixed while a large dark cloud layer and gray vertical veils under it visibly change shape and position over time.
raw_event_description: The sequence opens on a scrub-covered desert foreground with low hills along the horizon and a broad brown-gray cloud mass filling most of the sky. A dark horizontal cloud underside spans the middle and right portions of the sky, with a gray vertical veil near the center-left reaching from the cloud base toward the horizon. Over the sequence, the cloud textures reshape, the dark underside becomes more prominent across the center and right, and the gray veils beneath the cloud base shift and vary in width and darkness. Near the later frames, a lighter sky gap is visible below the cloud shelf near the center-right while small darker cloud fragments remain suspended beneath the main cloud layer. The land, hills, and foreground vegetation stay in the same positions in the frame.

reasons: The scene already contains the large cloud layer and gray vertical veil at the start.
The horizon, foreground, and cloud structures are visible across the frame.
There is no separate visible pre-event state before the cloud changes.
